summary: A modular collection of directories, activities, recognition, and opportunities to engage community members.
whenToUse: As a configurable page or section for community portals with multiple initiatives and content.
whenNotToUse: To replace a backend, an authentication system, persistent polls, or a contest platform.

props.name: members / sponsors / testimonials
props.description: Summaries of members, sponsors, and testimonials.

props.name: polls / nps / questions
props.description: Polls, 0–10 NPS rating, and questions with votes/answers.

props.name: invite
props.description: Invitation details; any sharing is delegated to the callback.

props.name: volunteerShifts / jobs
props.description: Selectable volunteer shifts and related job listings.

props.name: badges / streakDays
props.description: Badge collection and participation streak provided by the consumer.

props.name: raffle
props.description: List of entries and the winner, if chosen elsewhere.

props.name: onPollVote / onNpsRate / onQuestionVote / onQuestionReact
props.description: Pure action callbacks; the component does not persist votes or reactions.

props.name: onInviteShare / onShiftSelect / onRaffleEnter
props.description: Actions delegated to the consumer, with no automatic invitations, bookings, or draws.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the buttons and links in the content.
Activates an action via the native React Aria button.

accessibility: Sections have readable labels, each participant is also identified by name, and controls have text labels.
Trend and winner data are presented as text in addition to visual indicators.
responsive: Grids adapt to the available width and lists keep actions usable on narrow viewports.
customization: Sections are enabled by their respective data; colors, typography, and spacing use --dc-* tokens.
commonMistakes: The parent must update the data after the callbacks: the selection is not saved locally.
The raffle winner must be chosen and provided by an external process; no draw happens here.

examples.name: CommunityOverview
examples.title: Community overview
examples.description: Directory, activities, NPS feedback, opportunities, and content controlled via props.

limits: No persistence, invitation sending, authentication, voting, or random winner selection.
